'''''Salicornia perennis''''', [[Synonym (taxonomy)|synonym]] '''''Sarcocornia perennis''''',<ref name=POWO_225555-2/> otherwise known as '''perennial glasswort''', is a species of [[halophytes|halophytic]] perennial<ref>{{cite web |title=Wildflowers - Perennial Glasswort |url=http://www.dorsetnature.co.uk/pages-flower/wf-156.html |website=Dorset Nature |accessdate=9 June 2020}}</ref> plant within the family [[Amaranthaceae]]. It has a widespread but patchy native distribution, being found in parts of Western Europe, northern and southern Africa, North America from southeast Alaska to south Mexico, the Caribbean, and South America.<ref name=POWO_225555-2/> It is native to the coasts of southern Britain and Ireland,<ref>{{cite web |title=Sarcocornia perennis |url=https://species.nbnatlas.org/species/NHMSYS0000463218 |website=NBN Atlas |accessdate=9 June 2020}}</ref> where it is classified as nationally scarce.<ref>{{cite web |title=Sarcocornia perennis (Mill.) A.J. Scott - Perennial Glasswort |url=https://www.nhm.ac.uk/our-science/data/uk-species/species/sarcocornia_perennis.html |website=Natural History Museum |accessdate=9 June 2020}}</ref> The species flowers between July and October.<ref>{{cite web |title=Glassworts |url=http://webidguides.com/_templates/group_salicornia.html |website=Flora of East Anglia An Identification Guide |accessdate=9 June 2020}}</ref>
